sentences.display: A Greek sailing guide of the first century, the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea, describes this coast as "the Frankincense Country, mountainous and forbidding, wrapped in thick clouds and fog."

sentences.display: It names a harbour called Moscha, where ships took on the resin, under the control of the king's officers.
